scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @shriram/scripts exec tsx ./development/cleanup-ports.ts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @shriram/shared run build && pnpm --filter @shriram/api-client run build && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @shriram/scripts exec tsx ../tests/unit/shared.test.ts && pnpm --filter @shriram/scripts exec tsx ../tests/api/health.test.ts && pnpm --filter @shriram/scripts run validate:csv && pnpm --filter @shriram/scripts run validate:helmets
